label: Agent Skills, version file on demand, #21793
why: The skills move to the Agent Skills format, the roles move to the gpt-6 deployments and the actor loads each skill's version file on demand, in #21793. Full check with e2e, run once in each version-file mode on the same commit. The append-mode run is 20261106T195143Z-agent-skills-version-file-appended-21793-24c8. Every behavior scores the same in both. On demand, the actor loaded references/v8.md for each of the 15 skills it loaded that has a version file, every time before its first write, at four more actor turns across the four builds. actor.picks-allowed-tool is 0.889 in both modes, because in one replay the actor loads a skill where the item expects verify_changes. Studio has the preview turned off (#21637), so build.pages-render and build.entry-page-renders have no score and the run is adopted with --force.
